frame: leg frame: origin on the yaw axis at the floor plate underside; +x forward, +y outboard, +z up

links.femur_beam: 30x60x3 6061-T6 rect tube, centreline 65 mm exterior of the pivot-knee line
links.coxa_structure: two 6 mm 6061 side plates at x = +-46..52 with HK3012 bosses + three 6 mm hub plates

transmission.fleet_angle_note: inclination of each straight run to its drum's plane of rotation (the drum turns about z, the sector about x); a grooved capstan drum wants < ~1.5 deg. The runs have no fleet in x (planes x = +-r_drum).

knee.formula: tau_tibia = (r_drum/r_crank) * (delta_knee - psi) = (delta_knee - psi) / 2.5; theta_knee = tau_tibia - phi_femur - 180

transmission.hubs: crank plate A on a flange integral with the crank shaft; crank plate B on a 42CrMo4 hub (bore 24, 2 x 8x7 keys x 26, OD 30 = the left journal); link pulleys on 42CrMo4 hubs (2 x 10x8 keys x 24) with dowelled flanges; tibia carrier 2 x 10x8 keys x 50 in 6061

bearings.crank_shaft_in_coxa: 2 x HK3012 (PTI: Cr 11.5, C0r 17.3 kN) in bosses on the coxa cheeks
bearings.femur_carrier: 2 x HK3012 on the crank shaft
bearings.knee_pin_in_femur: 2 x HK3012 in bosses on the femur's knee cheeks
bearings.femur_sectors: bronze bushes on the crank shaft (bore 16)
bearings.knee_eccentric: HK3512 (PTI: C0r 20.25 kN), hollow sleeve bore 22

summary.rope_vs_coxa_frame_min_pair: rope_femur_B (femur band: A low / B low) vs hub_bot
